extracted.name: Pumpkin Chili
extracted.description: Pumpkin chili with beef, beans, tomatoes, and chili powder is slightly sweetened with pumpkin and flavored with pumpkin pie spice for a fun fall twist!
ingredient_lines: 1 (28 ounce) can peeled and diced tomatoes with juice
instruction_lines: Cook beef in a large pot over medium heat until browned and crumbly, about 5 to 7 minutes; drain.
Add onion and bell pepper; cook and stir for 5 minutes. Stir in beans, tomato juice, diced tomatoes, and pumpkin puree. Season with pumpkin pie spice, chili powder, and sugar.
Simmer chili until thickened and flavors have blended, about 1 hour.
